identity: A civic application form with applicant details, eligibility choices, a correspondence preference, a declaration, and a review step; some versions also include evidence rows or saved answers.

scenarios.name: branching
scenarios.screen: Several blank applicant fields and eligibility choices appear, with no correspondence option selected. Employment and dependant fields are hidden until the relevant answers are chosen; the review and receipt are closed.
never: An employment section already filled in before an employment answer is chosen.
Dependant fields already filled in before a dependant answer is chosen.

arrangements.text: Applicant fields run down the form, with eligibility choices below them and correspondence choices below those.
Applicant fields occupy two columns, with eligibility choices and correspondence choices in rows beneath them.

scenarios.name: checklist
scenarios.screen: Several blank applicant fields and an unselected correspondence choice appear above a short evidence list. Each evidence row has an attachment control and a document type choice; no files are attached, and the review and receipt are closed.
never: Document types already chosen for attached files.

arrangements.text: Applicant fields run down the form, with correspondence choices beneath them and evidence rows listed below.
Applicant fields occupy the left side of the task area, while evidence rows occupy the right side; correspondence choices sit beneath the applicant fields.

scenarios.name: saveresume
scenarios.screen: A saved application shows several applicant fields with a mix of accurate and out-of-date values, plus at least one detail still to complete. The correspondence choice and declaration still need checking before review; the receipt is closed.

arrangements.text: Saved applicant fields run down the form, with correspondence choices below them.
Saved applicant fields occupy two columns, with correspondence choices in a row beneath them.

scenarios.name: strict
scenarios.screen: Several blank applicant fields appear, including inputs for an identity number, a date, and a postcode with format guidance. The correspondence choice is unselected, and the review and receipt are closed.
never: A prefilled valid identity number, date, or postcode.
Validation errors displayed before any entry is made.

arrangements.text: Applicant fields run down the form, with format guidance beside the identity number, date, and postcode inputs and correspondence choices below the fields.
Applicant fields occupy two columns, with format guidance beneath the three format-sensitive inputs and correspondence choices across the bottom.
